escena: SCENE (cinematic product macro, a dark podcast studio at night): a large professional dynamic broadcast microphone on a boom arm fills the centre of the frame, seen almost head-on and very close, its metal grille in razor-sharp detail with dust and fine scratches; behind it, softly out of focus, a round ON-AIR style lamp glowing magenta-pink (#E86BD0) without any letters, and a wide circular wave of magenta light ripples outward from the microphone through light haze like a visible sound wave. The magenta light rims the microphone. Acoustic foam panels barely visible in the dark. COMPOSITION FOR A CIRCULAR CROP: everything important stays inside the central circle of the square; the four corners are only dark empty space.  Rich contrast, punchy saturated colour, real photographic detail and texture (dust, micro-scratches, real depth of field), no text, no readable letters or numbers, no logos of any other brand.
